story_samples.title: Mid-Scale Rescue on a Coarse Boundary
story_samples.summary: fpn_2 misses the narrow bark-versus-moss seam here. fpn_1 alone is noisy, but adding it to fpn_2 restores the thin vertical partition cleanly.

story_samples.title: Subset Choice Beats All-Scale Learned Weighting
story_samples.summary: The learned all-scale gate already favors coarse > mid > fine, yet the explicit coarse+mid subset still edges it out. Even fixed-uniform all-scale fusion beats the learned all-scale variant here.

story_samples.title: Coarse Signal Already Carries the Partition
story_samples.summary: On this crop the coarsest scale is already nearly optimal. The best two-scale fusion barely moves the score, while the finer-only controls are still distinctly weaker.

story_samples.title: Fine-Scale Native Resolution Collapses
story_samples.summary: The finest scale is weak even after alignment to 72x72, and becomes worse at its native 288x288 grid. Coarse features still recover the semantic partition cleanly.
